text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spikes in 5xx + gateway timeouts observed across inference-gateway-*-prod. Elevated error rate started ~11:02 UTC. Suspect backend KV/prefix cache instability (increased evictions). Paging oncall.

raj: Paging SRE oncall (kai). I'm seeing a sharp jump in 5xx from 0.3% -> 6.8% in the last 5m. Latency tail also increased. Logs show repeated cache-miss waterfall and some 'kv_read_timeout' in gateway logs.

olivia: I'm on it. Can someone dump the gateway error histogram + kv eviction rate for the last 10m? sending query.

dev-bot: Deploy logs: no recent deploys to inference-gateway or prefix-cache in last 2 hours.

olivia: pulling metrics now:
- gateway_5xx_rate: 6.8% (was 0.27% 15m ago)
- gateway_5xx_type: 72% backend_kv_errors, 18% upstream_timeout, 10% gateway_forward_errors
- kv_evictions/sec (prefix-cache): spike to 4300/s from baseline 50/s
- kv_read_latency P95 => 1200ms (baseline 40ms)

maria: Support is getting customer reports: 4 enterprise customers reporting timeouts for inference calls. Not yet escalated to SEV, but they're asking for ETA.

kai: I'm taking this pager. @olivia can you attach a short sample of gateway logs showing the KV errors and the request ids? I'll correlate with cache nodes.

olivia: sample logs below (redacted):
```
[11:06:23.456] gateway INFO req=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate backend=prefix-cache err=kv_read_timeout node=pc-12
[11:06:23.457] gateway WARN req=abcd1234 fallback=attempted -> model-serve-2
[11:06:27.891] gateway ERROR req=efgh5678 err=kv_corruption_check_failed prefix=usr:pf:abc
```

kai: Thanks. Two immediate hypotheses: 1) prefix-cache nodes are under memory pressure causing eviction storm -> KV misses -> downstream timeouts. 2) a recent background compaction job or TTL churn caused index drift.

raj: any signs of compaction jobs or rolling rebalances? dev-bot logs show a background SCAN on kv-shard-4 at 10:58 but it completed normally.

olivia: Running a quick health check across prefix-cache cluster:
```
$ kcctl cluster-status --cluster prefix-cache
nodes: 12
nodes_unhealthy: 2 (pc-11, pc-12)
mem_used_pct: 92%, 94% (pc-11, pc-12)
eviction_rate: 4300/s
io_wait: high
```

kai: OK. Plan (short):
1) Enable routing fallback for affected customer routes to model variant that reads from model-store (bypass prefix-cache) -> quick mitigation for customer impact.
2) Temporarily raise prefix-cache TTL and disable aggressive eviction policies on pc-11/pc-12.
3) If instability persists, take pc-11 and pc-12 out of rotation for a controlled restart and run kv_consistency_check.
4) Postmortem item: investigate compaction/TTL churn and autoscaler config.

olivia: Executing step 1 now: updating routing policy for customers tagged enterprise-high to route to fallback-model-store for 30m.

dev-bot: ROUTE UPDATE: enterprise-high -> fallback-model-store (applied: 11:12:05 UTC)

maria: Notifying affected customers: "We're seeing elevated timeouts; we've applied a temporary routing workaround while we stabilize cache nodes. Next update in 15m." (sent)

kai: Step 2: increasing prefix-cache default TTL from 60s -> 300s and relaxing eviction aggressiveness on pc-11/pc-12.

olivia: Applying config patch to pc-11 and pc-12:
```
PATCH /api/v1/cache/nodes/pc-11/config
{"default_ttl_s":300, "eviction_target_pct":85}
```

olivia: Patch applied to pc-11, pc-12. Observing mem_used% drop gradually, eviction_rate dropping to ~900/s after 3m.

raj: Gateway 5xx rate now 3.1% (down from 6.8%). Customer reports still trickling but fewer new timeouts.

kai: Good. Start controlled restart of pc-11 (drain + restart). I'll cordon pc-11 then restart service.

olivia: Drain logs:
```
$ kcctl drain pc-11 --timeout 90
drain-status: succeeded
$ systemctl restart prefix-cache
service: restarting...
```

dev-bot: pc-11 restart completed at 11:22:47 UTC. kcctl check: node pc-11 rejoined, mem_used% back to 42%.

olivia: Running kv_consistency_check on pc-11 (quick mode):
```
$ kvcheck --node pc-11 --quick
checked 1.2M prefixes, errors: 0
```

kai: Good. We're still seeing pc-12 higher mem usage (94%). Plan to cordon pc-12 next if error rate doesn't drop below 1% in 10m.

maria: Customer-facing status updated: "Workaround applied, partial mitigation. We're monitoring."

raj: Observed gateway 5xx 1.2% now. Timeout counts decreasing significantly.

olivia: Running a cluster-wide scan for index drift/compaction anomalies. Found repeated short compaction restarts on shard-9 at 10:58 which correlate with the initial spike. Filing follow-up.

kai: For immediate mitigation, let's leave routing fallback in place for 60m total. We'll also schedule a maintenance window for compaction tuning.

maria: Ops->support: advise impacted customers that primary mitigation is in place; expected full recovery in <45m unless pc-12 needs restart.

dev-bot: Alert: manual restart scheduled for pc-12 in 12m if mem_used% stays >90%.

olivia: Quick note: we saw a handful of kv_corruption_check_failed entries but kv_consistency_check returned no errors post-restart. Likely transient metadata mismatch during eviction flood.

raj: Oncall handoff: I need to step out in 10m. @kai can you take primary? I'll remain available via DMs.

kai: Taking primary. I'll escalate to infra if pc-12 restart is required. Setting incident severity to P2 and creating an incident issue.

incidents-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-0923-1867654321. Severity: P2. Linked: /incidents/INC-2026-0923-1867654321

maria: Recording customer impact: 4 enterprise tenants affected, 23k failed requests across 11:02-11:20 UTC. No data loss reported; degraded availability only.

olivia: Final check at 11:42 UTC: gateway 5xx = 0.45%, kv_eviction_rate = 60/s, pc-12 mem_used% trending down to 66% after GC.

kai: Great work. I'll keep the routing fallback until 12:12 UTC and then evaluate. Creating follow-up actions: compaction tuning, autoscaler memory thresholds, improved anomaly alerts on eviction spikes.

maria: I'll coordinate the customer follow-up and postmortem notes.

dev-bot: NOTE: no deploy rollbacks required.

kai: Handing off to night SRE pager in 30m. Closing live mitigation loop. If anything regresses, re-paging.

olivia: added quick timeline and logs to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Customer update queued for 11:55 UTC.

raj: thanks all. good mitigation and fast response.
